##### Project general facts

Seville is a refined lakeside community within the Bloom Living master development in Zayed City, Abu Dhabi, inspired by the charm of Mediterranean Spanish architecture. The project blends traditional aesthetics with contemporary design, offering a collection of villas and townhouses that emphasize space, light, and comfort. Residences range from two- and three-bedroom townhouses to spacious three- to six-bedroom villas, all designed with generous layouts, elegant proportions, and a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living.

Residents of Seville enjoy access to a wide range of community amenities designed to enhance both relaxation and social living. Landscaped gardens, open courtyards, and pedestrian-friendly pathways create a tranquil and welcoming environment, while the broader Bloom Living community provides access to parks, recreational facilities, and lifestyle destinations. The lakeside setting further enhances the atmosphere, offering scenic views and a peaceful backdrop for everyday life.

Interiors are finished with modern and elegant materials, complemented by high ceilings and large windows that allow natural light to fill each space while framing views of the surrounding greenery and lake. Kitchens are equipped, ensuring practicality and convenience for daily living. Units are offered unfurnished, giving homeowners the flexibility to personalize their interiors while benefiting from well-designed layouts and refined finishing standards.

##### Location description and benefits

Madinat Zayed in Abu Dhabi is a vibrant and welcoming community that beautifully combines the spirit of tradition with the comforts of modern living. Known for its spacious streets, well-planned infrastructure, and serene atmosphere, the area offers a peaceful lifestyle ideal for families and professionals alike. Its convenient location ensures easy access to all essential amenities, making everyday life both simple and enjoyable.

The area is home to a wide range of shopping centers, restaurants, and cafes, giving residents a pleasant mix of leisure and convenience. Families appreciate the abundance of schools, parks, and healthcare facilities that make living here both comfortable and secure. The presence of green spaces and well-maintained walkways adds a refreshing natural touch to the urban setting.

Madinat Zayed also offers excellent connectivity to the Abu Dhabi region, making it an ideal location for those who value both tranquility and accessibility. Its balance between modernity and local culture creates an atmosphere that feels both sophisticated and authentic. Residents can enjoy the charm of traditional Emirati life while benefiting from contemporary conveniences and urban development.
